The app shows its version in Settings and can update itself from this release.

## Changes
- Settings → App shows the installed version and where updates come from.
- The app checks for a new release at most every 6 hours, when it comes back to the foreground.
  When a new version is out, the Settings tab shows a badge and the App section offers "Update",
  which downloads the APK and installs it. Android asks you to confirm the installation.
- "Automatically check for updates" turns the automatic check off; "Check now" checks at once.
- Fix: Settings no longer crashes in release builds. The saved home networks were read with
  renamed field names, so the Wi-Fi name came back empty.

## Install
Installing this release over v0.0.2 keeps the session and the saved credentials. To update an
installed build use `adb install -r`, or the in-app "Update" button on v0.0.3 and later; do not
uninstall the app, that erases the session and the saved credentials.

The first update from v0.0.2 is manual: download the APK below. Android asks for permission to
install apps from this source; allow it once.

Requires Android 12 (API 31) or newer, arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a.
